name: Pinell de Solsonès (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged with three yellow pine cones with their stalks upward, two above and one below.
history: The official flag of Pinell de Solsonès is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with the three yellow pine cones of the arms with their stalks upward, each 2/7 of the height and 1/7 of the length of the cloth, two above and one below; approved on 17 November 2011 and published in the DOGC on 5 December 2011.

features.role: three pine cones, two above and one below
